name: Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception and Holy Family
shortName: Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception and Holy Family

boundary.description: From Blackrod Station, SE by the railway to the bridge that goes over it and by a bee-line across the fields to the Wigan – Bolton District boundary. Along that boundary and S along the Brook, including Mill Lane, Mill Courst and Millbrook Close in the Holy Family parish. Then along the diocesan boundary to the footpath near Mowpin Lodge, N along the footpath to Haigh Road , Toddington Lane, past, but excluding Freezeland Farm (i.e. along Haigh Civil Parish boundary) to and W along Wigan – Bolton District boundary and Chorley – Bolton boundary to the railway, and SE along the railway to Blackrod station.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between Holy Family and Our Lady of Immaculate Conception
internalBoundaries.description: From the diocesan boundary near Mowpin Lodge, by a bee-line to Wigan Road, along Wigan Road and Bolton Road to its junction with Hall Lane and by a bee-line to Borsdane Brook.
